newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kuehne & Nagel names W. Europe executive.
newsitem.headline: Kuehne & Nagel names W. Europe executive.

text.p: International freight forwarder Kuehne & Nagel International AG said it has appointed Hans Peter Kostan as chief executive Western Europe with effect from January 1.
Kostan, currently manager for Britain, Ireland and Scandinavia, will replace Alfred Floss-Kuehne, a company statement said.
He will be responsible for all countries in western Europe with the exception of Germany, the statement added.
Floss-Kuehne will in future act as a consultant for warehousing in the Benelux states and for European inland shipping.
